required_outcomes: Recognises the tenant has tried the landlord's suggestion, it works, and she will keep using it, monitor the door and report any recurrence.
Informs the landlord of the outcome (tenant using the key method, will report if it recurs) and that the request is being closed.
Closes the request without payment, recording the tenant's confirmation and the monitoring arrangement, and the tenant knows to get back in touch if the door gets worse.
acceptable_alternatives: Asking the landlord whether he still wants the contractor visit he mentioned for next month, given the fitter reported the frame wobbling, before or instead of closing.
Keeping the request open with a dated follow-up to check with the tenant in a few weeks instead of closing now.
positive_behaviours: Reminds the tenant to lock the door with the key, since with the latch held back it does not lock itself.
Records that the original intake category (Appliances) was wrong.
red_flags: Escalating to a human over a resolved routine request.
Booking a contractor when the landlord and tenant have agreed the workaround.
prohibited_actions: Instructing a contractor without the landlord's approval.
critical_failures: Leaving the case with no outcome: neither closed nor given a dated follow-up, and the landlord not told the workaround worked.
